plan.outcome_access: No candidate participant-level outcome record was requested, downloaded, received, opened, or inspected while PCQ-1.5 was implemented.

uncertainty_classes.method: Endpoint-specific method floors, covariance envelopes, compositional constraints, and log-scale propagation are fixed before measured outcomes.
uncertainty_classes.limitation: Source-native covariance remains unavailable and may not be replaced by a hidden independence assumption.
uncertainty_classes.consequence: Measured reports must show a covariance envelope or remain inconclusive until the provider supplies a covariance estimate.

uncertainty_classes.method: Existing evidence intervals and standard deviations are registered separately from numerical closure choices.
uncertainty_classes.limitation: Most inputs lack evidence-backed distribution families and joint correlations.
uncertainty_classes.consequence: Intervals support deterministic screening only; probabilistic output intervals and global variance attribution remain blocked.

uncertainty_classes.method: All seven immutable pulmonary definitions are compared over a fixed flow-age grid; aggregate-equivalent v4 and v7 share one equivalence group.
uncertainty_classes.limitation: The ensemble is a set of hypotheses, not a probability distribution over models.
uncertainty_classes.consequence: Between-structure spread is reported separately and no winning structure is selected from validation outcomes.

uncertainty_classes.method: Equilibrium pressure, PVR, RC time, volume-flow residence, and algebraic propagation are closed-form; local derivative estimates must converge across three perturbation sizes.
uncertainty_classes.limitation: Participant-cluster bootstrap convergence cannot be evaluated without an authorized decision-size cohort.
uncertainty_classes.consequence: Current numerical error is tested only for analytic design calculations; later resampling must add replicate-count stability before a qualification decision.

uncertainty_classes.method: Signed central log-elasticities screen the frozen flow-adaptive and capillary closure equations with perturbation convergence.
uncertainty_classes.limitation: A variance-based global analysis is not scientifically defined without joint input distributions and correlations.
uncertainty_classes.consequence: Local direction and magnitude may guide interpretation, but Sobol-like percentages and probabilistic rankings are forbidden.

uncertainty_classes.method: Pre-calibration design-matrix ranks test multipoint hemodynamics, H4 dynamics, age confounding, lobe composition, capillary geometry, and whole-transit delay decomposition.
uncertainty_classes.limitation: Rank is structural/local design evidence and does not guarantee practical identifiability in noisy small cohorts.
uncertainty_classes.consequence: Rank-deficient combinations stay independently fixed or are reported as non-identifiable; validation data are never optimized to a unique-looking solution.

observational_models.method: Use the larger of source-supplied mPAP standard uncertainty and 2 mmHg at every stage.
observational_models.covariance_handling: No covariance term is needed for the direct mPAP residual.
observational_models.failure_consequence: Missing uncertainty makes the endpoint inconclusive.

observational_models.method: First-order propagation for PVR=(mPAP-PAWP)/Q using 2 mmHg, 3 mmHg, and 10 percent floors.
observational_models.covariance_handling: If joint covariance is unavailable, report the attainable correlation envelope across all three inputs; do not silently assume independence.
observational_models.failure_consequence: A decision needing narrower uncertainty remains inconclusive.

observational_models.method: Use within-participant repeated-stage pressure-flow uncertainty and retain all stages as one cluster.
required_inputs: stage covariance or declared covariance envelope
cardiac output span at least 2 L/min
observational_models.covariance_handling: Stage covariance must be supplied or bracketed; ordinary unweighted slope error is descriptive only.
observational_models.failure_consequence: Slope precision is not decision-capable without repeated-stage covariance.

observational_models.method: Propagate complete stage-matched systolic PAP, diastolic PAP, heart rate, resistance, and compliance into RC summaries.
observational_models.covariance_handling: Joint stage covariance is source-required for inferential intervals.
observational_models.failure_consequence: Incomplete tuples are omitted only from H4 and reported as missing; primary H1-H3 remain retained.

observational_models.method: Analyse five fractions on the simplex and retain the 2 percentage-point per-lobe floor.
observational_models.covariance_handling: The sum-to-one constraint requires compositional covariance; independent lobe errors are forbidden.
observational_models.failure_consequence: Without covariance, only bounded perturbation screening and point-error gates are reported.

observational_models.method: Represent positive Vc on the log scale using at least the 8 percent method coefficient of variation.
observational_models.covariance_handling: Use source covariance when model and observed terms share inputs; otherwise expose a correlation envelope.
observational_models.failure_consequence: Regression r-squared below 0.95 or undocumented hemoglobin handling rejects the record.

observational_models.method: No uncertainty interval is evaluated until independent pre-capillary, post-capillary, and mixing delays are fixed.
observational_models.covariance_handling: Unavailable while the observation model is blocked.
observational_models.failure_consequence: Whole-pulmonary transit remains blocked and cannot validate capillary residence.

observational_models.method: Carry measured or independently evidenced hematocrit uncertainty once through the Vc observation model.
observational_models.covariance_handling: Covariance with Vc is source-required when the same measurement fit produces both.
observational_models.failure_consequence: Undocumented double correction rejects the record; missing covariance broadens or blocks inference.

observational_models.method: Propagate joint Vc and Q uncertainty into the derived Vc/Q residence proxy while keeping numerical closure exact.
observational_models.covariance_handling: If Vc-Q covariance is unavailable, report the rho=-1 to rho=+1 envelope.
observational_models.failure_consequence: Separate cohorts support only model-mediated compatibility, never a joint physiological claim.

identifiability_analyses.consequence: Resistance level and flow exponent cannot both be estimated from one stage.

identifiability_analyses.design: Three distinct flow stages spanning at least 2 L/min with observed PAWP.
identifiability_analyses.consequence: The two-parameter equilibrium flow law is locally distinguishable, subject to practical precision.

identifiability_analyses.design: Three equilibrium pressure-flow stages without H4 dynamics.
identifiability_analyses.consequence: Compliance level and exponent do not affect equilibrium H1-H3 and must not be inferred from them.

identifiability_analyses.design: Three distinct stages with independent PVR and RC-time information.
identifiability_analyses.consequence: Complete H4 dynamics can separate resistance and compliance terms; missing tuples remove that capability.

identifiability_analyses.design: Participants from one age band only.
identifiability_analyses.consequence: Baseline resistance and the band multiplier are confounded and remain independently fixed.

identifiability_analyses.design: Five normalized lobe fractions constrained to sum to one.
identifiability_analyses.consequence: Four compositional degrees are observable; absolute total regional flow is not identified by fractions alone.
Path count, equivalent diameter, and path length cannot be independently recovered from Vc; numerical choices remain explicit.

identifiability_analyses.design: One whole-pulmonary transit equals the sum of four delay components.
identifiability_analyses.consequence: The three extra delays require independent evidence before C2 can be compared.

identifiability_analyses.design: Residence is deterministically defined as Vc/Q.
identifiability_analyses.consequence: The algebraic identity checks coherence but supplies no third independent physiological observation.

next_step.deliverable: Run the frozen no-refit endpoint evaluator only on rights-authorized, source-disjoint observations and retain every eligible, partial, blocked, and failed result.
